component.name: LumaPrint
component.summary: Fine-art print layout, live softproofing and 16-bit color management

description.p: LumaPrint is a printer-independent 16-bit fine-art print layout, live softproofing, and ICC color management studio for Linux and CUPS, inspired by Epson Print Layout and TurboPrint Composer.

ul.li: 16-bit color pipeline with LittleCMS 2, ICC paper profiles, and automatic prevention of double color management
Interactive softproof with paper white simulation, viewing light temperatures (D50, D65, 3200K), and gamut warning
Advanced Black and White (ABW) mode with 2D color toning wheel, midtone control, and tone curves
Five studio layout modes: Standard, Collection Sheet (auto-nesting composer), 2-Stage Bento/Free Template Studio, Gallery Wrap, and Panorama
Direct CUPS / IPP integration with custom media (.emx) support and live ink level monitoring
